description: Write or revise mathematical research papers in Olivier Bousquet's preferred expository style: self-contained for motivated non-experts, rich in background and intuition, explicit about motivation and prior work, visually organized with diagrams/tables, progressively disclosed from overview to full proof detail, and candid about limitations and applicability. Use when drafting, restructuring, completing, reviewing, or polishing LaTeX papers, introductions, theorem sections, proof sections, examples, related-work sections, or submission-ready manuscripts.
